title: Read the localization download fallback
description: You follow the artifact directory check and protected download request.

steps.description: You import shutil and Path, then try to import Colab's files helper. Exceptions from that import or later calls reach the same handler.
You make artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. Otherwise, the helper prints No artifacts folder found.

steps.question: Which branch handles an exception from files.download?
steps.answer: The except block prints the helper-unavailable message and the exception text.

steps.description: You see that message in the recording. It identifies google.colab.files.download as unavailable in code-viz.
